CREATE TABLE `E_ACCOUNT_PERMISSION` (
  `AP_CA_ID` decimal(11,0) NOT NULL,
  `AP_ACL` char(4) NOT NULL,
  `AP_TAX_ID` char(20) NOT NULL,
  `AP_L_NAME` char(30) NOT NULL,
  `AP_F_NAME` char(30) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`AP_CA_ID`,`AP_TAX_ID`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`AP_CA_ID`) REFERENCES `E_CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT` (`CA_ID`)
);
CREATE TABLE `E_ADDRESS` (
  `AD_ID` decimal(11,0) PRIMARY KEY,
  `AD_LINE1` char(80) DEFAULT NULL,
  `AD_LINE2` char(80) DEFAULT NULL,
  `AD_ZC_CODE` char(12) NOT NULL,
  `AD_CTRY` char(80) DEFAULT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (`AD_ZC_CODE`) REFERENCES `E_ZIP_CODE` (`ZC_CODE`)
);
CREATE TABLE `E_BROKER` (
  `B_ID` decimal(11,0)  PRIMARY KEY,
  `B_ST_ID` char(4) NOT NULL,
  `B_NAME` char(100) NOT NULL,
  `B_NUM_TRADES` decimal(9,0) NOT NULL,
  `B_COMM_TOTAL` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (`B_ST_ID`) REFERENCES `E_STATUS_TYPE` (`ST_ID`)
);
CREATE TABLE `E_CASH_TRANSACTION` (
  `CT_T_ID` decimal(15,0) PRIMARY KEY,
  `CT_DTS` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `CT_AMT` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL,
  `CT_NAME` char(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (`CT_T_ID`) REFERENCES `E_TRADE` (`T_ID`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);
CREATE TABLE `E_CHARGE` (
  `CH_TT_ID` char(3) NOT NULL,
  `CH_C_TIER` decimal(1,0) NOT NULL,
  `CH_CHRG` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`CH_TT_ID`,`CH_C_TIER`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`CH_TT_ID`) REFERENCES `E_TRADE_TYPE` (`TT_ID`)
);
CREATE TABLE `E_COMMISSION_RATE` (
  `CR_C_TIER` decimal(1,0) NOT NULL,
  `CR_TT_ID` char(3) NOT NULL,
  `CR_EX_ID` char(6) NOT NULL,
  `CR_FROM_QTY` decimal(9,0) NOT NULL,
  `CR_TO_QTY` decimal(9,0) NOT NULL,
  `CR_RATE` decimal(5,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`CR_C_TIER`,`CR_TT_ID`,`CR_EX_ID`,`CR_FROM_QTY`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`CR_EX_ID`) REFERENCES `E_EXCHANGE` (`EX_ID`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`CR_TT_ID`) REFERENCES `E_TRADE_TYPE` (`TT_ID`)
);
CREATE TABLE `E_COMPANY` (
  `CO_ID` decimal(11,0) PRIMARY KEY,
  `CO_ST_ID` char(4) NOT NULL,
  `CO_NAME` char(60) NOT NULL,
  `CO_IN_ID` char(2) NOT NULL,
  `CO_SP_RATE` char(4) NOT NULL,
  `CO_CEO` char(100) NOT NULL,
  `CO_AD_ID` decimal(11,0) NOT NULL,
  `CO_DESC` char(150) NOT NULL,
  `CO_OPEN_DATE` date DEFAULT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (`CO_AD_ID`) REFERENCES `E_ADDRESS` (`AD_ID`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`CO_IN_ID`) REFERENCES `E_INDUSTRY` (`IN_ID`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`CO_ST_ID`) REFERENCES `E_STATUS_TYPE` (`ST_ID`)
);
CREATE TABLE `E_COMPANY_COMPETITOR` (
  `CP_CO_ID` decimal(11,0) NOT NULL,
  `CP_COMP_CO_ID` decimal(11,0) NOT NULL,
  `CP_IN_ID` char(2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`CP_CO_ID`,`CP_COMP_CO_ID`,`CP_IN_ID`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`CP_COMP_CO_ID`) REFERENCES `E_COMPANY` (`CO_ID`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`CP_CO_ID`) REFERENCES `E_COMPANY` (`CO_ID`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`CP_IN_ID`) REFERENCES `E_INDUSTRY` (`IN_ID`)
);
CREATE TABLE `E_CUSTOMER` (
  `C_ID` decimal(11,0) PRIMARY KEY,
  `C_TAX_ID` char(20) NOT NULL,
  `C_ST_ID` char(4) NOT NULL,
  `C_L_NAME` char(30) NOT NULL,
  `C_F_NAME` char(30) NOT NULL,
  `C_M_NAME` char(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  `C_GNDR` char(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  `C_TIER` decimal(1,0) NOT NULL,
  `C_DOB` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `C_AD_ID` decimal(11,0) NOT NULL,
  `C_CTRY_1` char(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `C_AREA_1` char(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `C_LOCAL_1` char(10) DEFAULT NULL,
  `C_EXT_1` char(5) DEFAULT NULL,
  `C_CTRY_2` char(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `C_AREA_2` char(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `C_LOCAL_2` char(10) DEFAULT NULL,
  `C_EXT_2` char(5) DEFAULT NULL,
  `C_CTRY_3` char(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `C_AREA_3` char(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `C_LOCAL_3` char(10) DEFAULT NULL,
  `C_EXT_3` char(5) DEFAULT NULL,
  `C_EMAIL_1` char(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `C_EMAIL_2` char(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (`C_ST_ID`) REFERENCES `E_STATUS_TYPE` (`ST_ID`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`C_AD_ID`) REFERENCES `E_ADDRESS` (`AD_ID`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);
CREATE TABLE `E_CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT` (
  `CA_ID` decimal(11,0) PRIMARY KEY,
  `CA_B_ID` decimal(11,0) NOT NULL,
  `CA_C_ID` decimal(11,0) NOT NULL,
  `CA_NAME` char(50) NOT NULL,
  `CA_TAX_ST` decimal(1,0) NOT NULL,
  `CA_BAL` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (`CA_B_ID`) REFERENCES `E_BROKER` (`B_ID`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`CA_C_ID`) REFERENCES `E_CUSTOMER` (`C_ID`)
);
CREATE TABLE `E_CUSTOMER_TAXRATE` (
  `CX_TX_ID` char(4) NOT NULL,
  `CX_C_ID` decimal(11,0) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`CX_TX_ID`,`CX_C_ID`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`CX_C_ID`) REFERENCES `E_CUSTOMER` (`C_ID`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`CX_TX_ID`) REFERENCES `E_TAXRATE` (`TX_ID`)
);
CREATE TABLE `E_DAILY_MARKET` (
  `DM_DATE` date NOT NULL,
  `DM_S_SYMB` char(15) NOT NULL,
  `DM_CLOSE` decimal(8,2) NOT NULL,
  `DM_HIGH` decimal(8,2) NOT NULL,
  `DM_LOW` decimal(8,2) NOT NULL,
  `DM_VOL` decimal(12,0) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`DM_DATE`,`DM_S_SYMB`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`DM_S_SYMB`) REFERENCES `E_SECURITY` (`S_SYMB`)
);
CREATE TABLE `E_EXCHANGE` (
  `EX_ID` char(6) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  `EX_NAME` char(100) NOT NULL,
  `EX_NUM_SYMB` decimal(6,0) NOT NULL,
  `EX_OPEN` decimal(4,0) NOT NULL,
  `EX_CLOSE` decimal(4,0) NOT NULL,
  `EX_DESC` char(150) DEFAULT NULL,
  `EX_AD_ID` decimal(11,0) NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (`EX_AD_ID`) REFERENCES `E_ADDRESS` (`AD_ID`)
);
CREATE TABLE `E_FINANCIAL` (
  `FI_CO_ID` decimal(11,0) NOT NULL,
  `FI_YEAR` decimal(4,0) NOT NULL,
  `FI_QTR` decimal(1,0) NOT NULL,
  `FI_QTR_START_DATE` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `FI_REVENUE` decimal(15,2) NOT NULL,
  `FI_NET_EARN` decimal(15,2) NOT NULL,
  `FI_BASIC_EPS` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL,
  `FI_DILUT_EPS` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL,
  `FI_MARGIN` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL,
  `FI_INVENTORY` decimal(15,2) NOT NULL,
  `FI_ASSETS` decimal(15,2) NOT NULL,
  `FI_LIABILITY` decimal(15,2) NOT NULL,
  `FI_OUT_BASIC` decimal(12,0) NOT NULL,
  `FI_OUT_DILUT` decimal(12,0) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`FI_CO_ID`,`FI_YEAR`,`FI_QTR`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`FI_CO_ID`) REFERENCES `E_COMPANY` (`CO_ID`)
);
CREATE TABLE `E_HOLDING` (
  `H_T_ID` decimal(15,0) PRIMARY KEY,
  `H_CA_ID` decimal(11,0) NOT NULL,
  `H_S_SYMB` char(15) NOT NULL,
  `H_DTS` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `H_PRICE` decimal(8,2) NOT NULL,
  `H_QTY` decimal(9,0) NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (`H_CA_ID`, `H_S_SYMB`) REFERENCES `E_HOLDING_SUMMARY` (`HS_CA_ID`, `HS_S_SYMB`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`H_T_ID`) REFERENCES `E_TRADE` (`T_ID`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);
CREATE TABLE `E_HOLDING_HISTORY` (
  `HH_H_T_ID` decimal(15,0) NOT NULL,
  `HH_T_ID` decimal(15,0) NOT NULL,
  `HH_BEFORE_QTY` decimal(9,0) NOT NULL,
  `HH_AFTER_QTY` decimal(9,0) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`HH_H_T_ID`,`HH_T_ID`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`HH_T_ID`) REFERENCES `E_TRADE` (`T_ID`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`HH_H_T_ID`) REFERENCES `E_HOLDING` (`H_T_ID`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);
CREATE TABLE `E_HOLDING_SUMMARY` (
  `HS_CA_ID` decimal(11,0) NOT NULL,
  `HS_S_SYMB` char(15) NOT NULL,
  `HS_QTY` decimal(9,0) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`HS_CA_ID`,`HS_S_SYMB`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`HS_CA_ID`) REFERENCES `E_CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT` (`CA_ID`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`HS_S_SYMB`) REFERENCES `E_SECURITY` (`S_SYMB`)
);
CREATE TABLE `E_INDUSTRY` (
  `IN_ID` char(2) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  `IN_NAME` char(50) NOT NULL,
  `IN_SC_ID` char(2) NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (`IN_SC_ID`) REFERENCES `E_SECTOR` (`SC_ID`)
);
CREATE TABLE `E_LAST_TRADE` (
  `LT_S_SYMB` char(15) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  `LT_DTS` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `LT_PRICE` decimal(8,2) NOT NULL,
  `LT_OPEN_PRICE` decimal(8,2) NOT NULL,
  `LT_VOL` decimal(12,0) NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (`LT_S_SYMB`) REFERENCES `E_SECURITY` (`S_SYMB`)
);
CREATE TABLE `E_NEWS_ITEM` (
  `NI_ID` decimal(11,0) PRIMARY KEY,
  `NI_HEADLINE` char(80) NOT NULL,
  `NI_SUMMARY` char(255) NOT NULL,
  `NI_ITEM` longtext NOT NULL,
  `NI_DTS` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `NI_SOURCE` char(30) NOT NULL,
  `NI_AUTHOR` char(30) DEFAULT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE `E_NEWS_XREF` (
  `NX_NI_ID` decimal(11,0) NOT NULL,
  `NX_CO_ID` decimal(11,0) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`NX_NI_ID`,`NX_CO_ID`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`NX_CO_ID`) REFERENCES `E_COMPANY` (`CO_ID`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`NX_NI_ID`) REFERENCES `E_NEWS_ITEM` (`NI_ID`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);
CREATE TABLE `E_SECTOR` (
  `SC_ID` char(2) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  `SC_NAME` char(30) NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE `E_SECURITY` (
  `S_SYMB` char(15) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  `S_ISSUE` char(6) NOT NULL,
  `S_ST_ID` char(4) NOT NULL,
  `S_NAME` char(70) NOT NULL,
  `S_EX_ID` char(6) NOT NULL,
  `S_CO_ID` decimal(11,0) NOT NULL,
  `S_NUM_OUT` decimal(12,0) NOT NULL,
  `S_START_DATE` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `S_EXCH_DATE` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `S_PE` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL,
  `S_52WK_HIGH` decimal(8,2) NOT NULL,
  `S_52WK_HIGH_DATE` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `S_52WK_LOW` decimal(8,2) NOT NULL,
  `S_52WK_LOW_DATE` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `S_DIVIDEND` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL,
  `S_YIELD` decimal(5,2) NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (`S_CO_ID`) REFERENCES `E_COMPANY` (`CO_ID`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`S_EX_ID`) REFERENCES `E_EXCHANGE` (`EX_ID`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`S_ST_ID`) REFERENCES `E_STATUS_TYPE` (`ST_ID`)
);
CREATE TABLE `E_SETTLEMENT` (
  `SE_T_ID` decimal(15,0) PRIMARY KEY,
  `SE_CASH_TYPE` char(40) NOT NULL,
  `SE_CASH_DUE_DATE` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `SE_AMT` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (`SE_T_ID`) REFERENCES `E_TRADE` (`T_ID`)
);
CREATE TABLE `E_STATUS_TYPE` (
  `ST_ID` char(4) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  `ST_NAME` char(10) NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE `E_TAXRATE` (
  `TX_ID` char(4) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  `TX_NAME` char(50) NOT NULL,
  `TX_RATE` decimal(6,5) NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE `E_TRADE` (
  `T_ID` decimal(15,0) PRIMARY KEY,
  `T_DTS` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `T_ST_ID` char(4) NOT NULL,
  `T_TT_ID` char(3) NOT NULL,
  `T_IS_CASH` char(1) NOT NULL,
  `T_S_SYMB` char(15) NOT NULL,
  `T_QTY` decimal(9,0) NOT NULL,
  `T_BID_PRICE` decimal(8,2) NOT NULL,
  `T_CA_ID` decimal(11,0) NOT NULL,
  `T_EXEC_NAME` char(64) NOT NULL,
  `T_TRADE_PRICE` decimal(8,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `T_CHRG` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL,
  `T_COMM` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL,
  `T_TAX` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL,
  `T_LIFO` char(1) NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (`T_CA_ID`) REFERENCES `E_CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT` (`CA_ID`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`T_ST_ID`) REFERENCES `E_STATUS_TYPE` (`ST_ID`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`T_S_SYMB`) REFERENCES `E_SECURITY` (`S_SYMB`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`T_TT_ID`) REFERENCES `E_TRADE_TYPE` (`TT_ID`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);
CREATE TABLE `E_TRADE_HISTORY` (
  `TH_T_ID` decimal(15,0) NOT NULL,
  `TH_DTS` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `TH_ST_ID` char(4) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`TH_T_ID`,`TH_ST_ID`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`TH_ST_ID`) REFERENCES `E_STATUS_TYPE` (`ST_ID`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`TH_T_ID`) REFERENCES `E_TRADE` (`T_ID`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);
CREATE TABLE `E_TRADE_REQUEST` (
  `TR_T_ID` decimal(15,0) NOT NULL,
  `TR_TT_ID` char(3) NOT NULL,
  `TR_S_SYMB` char(15) NOT NULL,
  `TR_QTY` decimal(9,0) NOT NULL,
  `TR_BID_PRICE` decimal(8,2) NOT NULL,
  `TR_CA_ID` decimal(11,0) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`TR_T_ID`,`TR_TT_ID`,`TR_CA_ID`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`TR_T_ID`) REFERENCES `E_TRADE` (`T_ID`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`TR_TT_ID`) REFERENCES `E_TRADE_TYPE` (`TT_ID`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`TR_S_SYMB`) REFERENCES `E_SECURITY` (`S_SYMB`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`TR_CA_ID`) REFERENCES `E_CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT` (`CA_ID`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);
CREATE TABLE `E_TRADE_TYPE` (
  `TT_ID` char(3) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  `TT_NAME` char(12) NOT NULL,
  `TT_IS_SELL` char(1) NOT NULL,
  `TT_IS_MRKT` char(1) NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE `E_WATCH_ITEM` (
  `WI_WL_ID` decimal(11,0) NOT NULL,
  `WI_S_SYMB` char(15) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`WI_WL_ID`,`WI_S_SYMB`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`WI_S_SYMB`) REFERENCES `E_SECURITY` (`S_SYMB`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`WI_WL_ID`) REFERENCES `E_WATCH_LIST` (`WL_ID`)
);
CREATE TABLE `E_WATCH_LIST` (
  `WL_ID` decimal(11,0) PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  `WL_C_ID` decimal(11,0) NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (`WL_C_ID`) REFERENCES `E_CUSTOMER` (`C_ID`)
);
CREATE TABLE `E_ZIP_CODE` (
  `ZC_CODE` char(12) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  `ZC_TOWN` char(80) NOT NULL,
  `ZC_DIV` char(80) NOT NULL
);

Background / Context  
The project involves developing a decision support system benchmarked against the TPC-H standard published by the Transaction Processing Performance Council (TPC). TPC-H is used to evaluate the performance of decision support systems that handle business-oriented ad hoc queries.

Objectives  
1. To implement a robust decision support system for managing complex relational databases.  
2. To provide a high-performance environment for processing large volumes of queries and transactions.  
3. To comply with TPC-H benchmarking standards to ensure system reliability and efficiency.

Stakeholders & Users  
- Administrators: Responsible for managing database configuration and system performance.  
- Data Analysts: Use the system to query and analyze data for decision-making purposes.  
- IT Support Staff: Provide technical support and maintenance for the system's operations.

Functional Descriptions  
1. User Management:  
   - Manage user permissions and access levels via `E_ACCOUNT_PERMISSION`.  
  
2. Data Storage and Maintenance:  
   - Store customer, account, and transaction details using tables like `E_CUSTOMER`, `E_CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT`, and `E_CASH_TRANSACTION`.  
   - Track market data with `E_DAILY_MARKET` and `E_FINANCIAL`.  

3. Transaction Processing:  
   - Process trade and settlement records through `E_TRADE` and `E_SETTLEMENT`.  
   - Manage historical trade data with `E_TRADE_HISTORY` and `E_HOLDING_HISTORY`.  

4. Market Information:  
   - Maintain and update market information related to securities and exchanges (`E_SECURITY`, `E_EXCHANGE`).  

5. Reporting and Analysis:  
   - Generate reports on industry and company performance using `E_INDUSTRY`, `E_COMPANY`, and related financial tables.

Non-Functional Descriptions  
1. Performance:  
   - The system should efficiently handle a high volume of transactions and complex queries in line with TPC-H performance benchmarks.  

2. Scalability:  
   - Ability to scale with increasing data volume and user demand without degradation of performance.  

3. Security:  
   - Implement robust security measures to protect sensitive financial and personal data.  

4. Reliability:  
   - Ensure consistent uptime and data integrity across all database operations.
nl_text: The schemabench_0134 database is a comprehensive system for managing financial data, particularly for companies and their interactions with customers and the stock market. It consists of 33 tables, each representing a distinct entity or relationship within this domain. The E_ACCOUNT_PERMISSION table stores information about account permissions, linking customer accounts to specific permissions and tax IDs. The E_ADDRESS table holds address details, with each address associated with a unique zip code from the E_ZIP_CODE table. The E_BROKER table contains information about brokers, including their status, number of trades, and commission total. The E_CASH_TRANSACTION table tracks cash transactions, referencing the E_TRADE table for trade details. The E_CHARGE table stores charge information, linked to trade types in the E_TRADE_TYPE table. The E_COMMISSION_RATE table contains commission rates for different trade types, exchanges, and quantity ranges. The E_COMPANY table stores company data, including their status, name, industry, and address, with foreign keys referencing the E_ADDRESS, E_INDUSTRY, and E_STATUS_TYPE tables. The E_COMPANY_COMPETITOR table lists competitors for each company, referencing the E_COMPANY and E_INDUSTRY tables. The E_CUSTOMER table stores customer information, including their tax ID, status, and address, with a foreign key referencing the E_ADDRESS table. The E_CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT table links customers to their accounts, referencing the E_BROKER and E_CUSTOMER tables. The E_CUSTOMER_TAXRATE table stores tax rates for each customer, referencing the E_CUSTOMER and E_TAXRATE tables. The E_DAILY_MARKET table tracks daily market data for each security, referencing the E_SECURITY table. The E_EXCHANGE table stores exchange information, including their name, number of symbols, and address, with a foreign key referencing the E_ADDRESS table. The E_FINANCIAL table contains financial data for each company, including revenue, net earnings, and basic and diluted earnings per share. The E_HOLDING table stores holding information, referencing the E_HOLDING_SUMMARY and E_TRADE tables. The E_HOLDING_HISTORY table tracks changes in holdings over time, referencing the E_HOLDING and E_TRADE tables. The E_HOLDING_SUMMARY table provides a summary of holdings for each customer account, referencing the E_CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT and E_SECURITY tables. The E_INDUSTRY table stores industry information, including the sector ID, with a foreign key referencing the E_SECTOR table. The E_LAST_TRADE table tracks the last trade for each security, referencing the E_SECURITY table. The E_NEWS_ITEM table stores news items, including headlines, summaries, and items, with a foreign key referencing the E_COMPANY table. The E_NEWS_XREF table links news items to companies, referencing the E_NEWS_ITEM and E_COMPANY tables. The E_SECTOR table stores sector information, including the sector name. The E_SECURITY table stores security information, including the symbol, issue, status, exchange, and company ID, with foreign keys referencing the E_COMPANY, E_EXCHANGE, and E_STATUS_TYPE tables. The E_SETTLEMENT table tracks settlements, referencing the E_TRADE table. The E_STATUS_TYPE table stores status type information, including the status name. The E_TAXRATE table stores tax rate information, including the tax name and rate. The E_TRADE table stores trade information, including the trade date, status, trade type, security symbol, and customer account ID, with foreign keys referencing the E_CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT, E_STATUS_TYPE, E_SECURITY, and E_TRADE_TYPE tables. The E_TRADE_HISTORY table tracks the status history of each trade, referencing the E_TRADE and E_STATUS_TYPE tables. The E_TRADE_REQUEST table stores trade requests, referencing the E_TRADE, E_TRADE_TYPE, E_SECURITY, and E_CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT tables. The E_TRADE_TYPE table stores trade type information, including the trade name, sell flag, and market flag. The E_WATCH_ITEM table stores watch list items, referencing the E_SECURITY and E_WATCH_LIST tables. The E_WATCH_LIST table stores watch lists, referencing the customer ID in the E_CUSTOMER table.
